Hi Michael, I’m reaching out on behalf of Jon Clark regarding your 2016 Nissan Altima with 83,223 miles. We're interested, but the $12,600 asking price is notably above the current KBB private party valuation of ~$11,765 for this model year and mileage. Given that, our opening offer would start at $10,200, and that's heavily contingent on a transparent mechanical history.

2016 Altimas have documented concerns around CVT transmission longevity, struts, and exhaust/rust issues. Could you please provide complete maintenance records, detail any past or ongoing mechanical problems, and confirm the current condition of the transmission, brakes, suspension, and tires? Once I review the history and account for any immediate maintenance or repairs, I’ll adjust the offer accordingly to reflect fair market value. Looking forward to your records.
